name: Tomi Sarjamo
title: Senior DevOps Engineer & Full-Stack Developer
about: Hello, I am Tomi Sarjamo, a Senior DevOps Engineer and Full-Stack Developer specializing in cloud-native platforms, GitOps, and AI-driven development. I have a strong track record in architecting scalable delivery workflows and developing complex financial and industrial software solutions. Passionate about developer experience and platform automation.

experience.description: Architecting a DevOps portal using Vue.js, Node.js, and Python. Streamlining delivery workflows through AI-driven practices and managing scalable AKS/OpenShift environments with GitOps (ArgoCD) and Terraform.
Full-stack development for banking and finance systems, focusing on credit granting and financing decision applications. Stack: React, TypeScript, Java/Spring Boot, Kafka, and Test Automation.
Worked on embedded systems and industrial AC drives. Developed internal Automated Testing Frameworks (ATF) using C#, .NET, C++, and Python. Focused on fieldbus programming and CI/CD pipelines.
Full-stack consulting for public and private sector clients using open-source technologies. Implemented E2E testing, Keycloak auth, and observability solutions (ELK Stack).
Architecture design and troubleshooting for complex Java-based systems. Managed containerized environments with Kubernetes and Docker for various client projects.
Developed intelligent traffic solutions and UI configurations for Finnish cities. Worked on Android cycle applications, traffic calculations (Java/Python), and data analysis using ELK.
Designed and implemented automated testing for frequency converters and industrial drives using C# and Python. Maintained integration servers and automated scripts.

education.description: Specialized in Electronics Design and Software Development.

Computer Science studies focusing on modern software development, including: Full Stack Open, Test-Driven Development, Securing Software WEB Server Programming, Programming MOOC Java/Python (Advanced course) and Databases.
